name: Jovial 100% Organic Brown Rice Penne (Cooked Soft)
whyItWorks: Traditional Tuscan bronze-die pressed brown rice pasta. Provides clean whole grain carbohydrates without wheat fructans. Must be cooked until soft to ensure ease of breakdown.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Boil in plenty of salted water for 11–12 minutes. Test a piece to ensure the center core is tender before draining.
